A 35-year-old woman presented 11 weeks postpartum with right breast erythema and pain. She had experienced three prior episodes of similar symptoms treated at outside hospitals, with the most recent occurring at 9 weeks postpartum. Medical history includes depression and previous treatment with cabergoline until 2016. During her first trimester of pregnancy, hormone levels were normal. Postpartum, she continued to express an excessive amount of milk despite attempts to wean. No recurrent headaches or visual changes were reported. Her menstrual cycle had not resumed, and medications included multivitamins.
A 5 cm × 8 cm area of erythema and induration on the medial aspect of the right breast. No fluctuance was present, but a milky, nonpurulent discharge was easily expressed from both breasts.
